Subject: MAP: SOC 2 evidence scrub sprint, SIG gaps & DPA carveouts

Hi Asha / Sanjay —

Thanks for the quick conversation earlier. I wanted to capture a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the security and compliance gates we discussed so we can align expectations and timing on the Fintegral evaluation. High-level asks here: SOC 2 Type II evidence, SIG/CAIQ matrix completion, DPA redline window (legal), and clarity on data retention/residency carveouts.

Proposed sprint plan (short):
- Week 1 (Sep 27–Oct 1): SOC 2 evidence scrub — we surface control artifacts and owners
- Week 2 (Oct 4–Oct 8): SIG/CAIQ completion & gap table (we’ll pre-populate answers)
- Week 3 (Oct 11–Oct 22): DPA negotiation window (30-day redline + DocuSign)

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm any EU residency restrictions or data locality must-haves
2) Confirm a 30-day DPA redline window works for procurement/legal
3) Share your internal SIG/Questionnaire (if you already have one) — I attached a short SOC 2 summary and our SIG gap template to start.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_Type2-summary.pdf, SIG_gap_table.xlsx

If that timeline looks reasonable, I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff on Monday Sep 27 to walk owners through the evidence intake.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Asha Venkataraman <asha@fintegral.com>

Cc: Sanjay Rao <ciso@fintegral.com>, procurement@fintegral.com, security@fintegral.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 evidence scrub sprint, SIG gaps & DPA carveouts

Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Residency: We operate primarily in US and EU; anything touching EU customer data must remain in EU regions or be processed under EU SCCs.
- SIG: We prefer SIG/CAIQ answers up-front; please call out controls you cannot attest to and we’ll note compensating controls.
- DPA: Procurement requires a 30-day redline review window but will want visibility into specific retention periods (we have a default 7 year archival requirement for transactional records).

I’ve attached our security intake spreadsheet (Fintegral_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx) — it’s a living doc that security/legal will update. Can your team pre-populate expected artifact locations for SOC 2 (e.g., point to SOC2_Type2-summary.pdf) so our reviewers can expedite?

Sanjay — looping you for SIG-specific asks.

Thanks,
Asha Venkataraman
Director, Strategic Programs, Fintegral
asha@fintegral.com

Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 evidence scrub sprint, SIG gaps & DPA carveouts

Thanks Asha — I pulled together the initial mapping for SOC 2 artifacts and owners so your reviewers can find materials quickly. Two quick notes up-front:

- SOC 2 artifacts: We will provide the Type II report, description of controls, system configuration snapshots (redacted), and sample logs for the evidence sprint. I’ve listed owners below:
  - SOC 2 report & control narrative: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com)
  - Infrastructure diagrams + network segmentation: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.com)
  - Logging & retention samples: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com)

- SIG pre-fill: We will pre-populate the bulk of the SIG/CAIQ answers; please mark any controls you want clarified (column: FINTEGRAL_NEEDS_CLARITY) and we’ll add inline comments to SIG_gap_table.xlsx.

- Data retention/residency: Our standard retention policy is 2 years for generated inference logs by default; we can offer a 7-year archival path for transactional datasets under contract and support region-specific scoping (EU-only processing) with private deployment options. We’ll call out these carveouts explicitly in the DPA redline.

I’ve attached a working SIG_gap_table.xlsx that pre-fills our answers and highlights two controls we expect to need compensating controls for (listed in the sheet).

If the schedule stands, I’ll run the evidence intake session on Sep 28 (30 min) for evidence owners. Kimberly — can you confirm you’ll send the calendar invite?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 evidence scrub sprint, SIG gaps & DPA carveouts

Kimberly / Neha — appreciate the plan. A couple of gating items from Fintegral security/legal before we accept the MAP timeline: 

1) SIG completion: We require SIG/CAIQ completed to at least 95% with documented compensating controls before any production data access. Can Redwood commit to the pre-population cadence you described?
2) Data flows: We need a simple data-flow diagram that highlights EU customer-data paths and where inference outputs may be stored. Please include retention buckets and KMS key ownership for EU data.
3) DPA timing: Procurement confirms a 30-day review window; legal wants an initial redline delivered by Oct 4 so we can target signature by Nov 4.

Forwarding procurement note for transparency — procurement@fintegral.com wrote: "We require visibility into retention carveouts and an escrow/archival plan if we agree to >2 year retention."

If you can confirm the SIG pre-fill and a data-flow diagram by Oct 1, we’ll mark the sprint green.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Chief Information Security Officer, Fintegral
ciso@fintegral.com
